text: Stop ignoring this RBI news. It just raised your EMI by seven hundred sixty eight rupees.
On a fifty lakh, twenty year home loan. Watch the domino effect.
Domino one. On October seventh, the RBI raised the repo rate to five point five percent.
Domino two. Banks follow. SBI raised loan rates by a quarter percent.
Domino three. Your loan rate goes from seven point five, to seven point seven five. Your EMI jumps by seven hundred sixty eight rupees a month. About one point eight four lakh more, over the loan.
Domino four. Higher EMIs. Families spend less.
Domino five. Companies sell less. That can hit stock prices.
But one domino falls the other way. FD rates can rise too, so savers can earn more.
Follow for money news that hits your wallet. And stop ignoring this RBI news.
